mainEntity.name: How long does a full bathroom renovation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a full bathroom renovation can vary significantly, generally ranging from 3 to 8 weeks. Factors influencing this timeline include the complexity of the design, the extent of structural changes, lead times for materials and fixtures, and the need for permits. Unexpected issues like hidden water damage can also extend the project. Ensuring all materials are on-site before starting can help streamline the process.
